text: The 2025 loss area is classified as native forest by the MGAP forest map 2021. This source identifies 13.1 hectares of the event area as native forest, with only 0.4 hectares outside mapped forest and none as planted forest. This classification is supported by the JRC GFC2020, which agrees that the area was forest in 2020. The Hansen GFC data shows a tree-cover loss of 13.5 hectares in 2025. Therefore, the primary source classifying this area as native forest is the MGAP forest map.
